name: Pension Haus Lechleitner Helga
beschreibung:
Overview

The Haus Lechleitner Helga is a private holiday apartment rental in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal in Außerfern (district of Reutte, Tyrol). The accommodation is listed at the address Nesselwängle 53 with the postal code 6672 and can be reached by telephone on +43 5675 8278. Nesselwängle lies at around 1,136 metres above sea level at the foot of Rote Flüh and Gimpel and is one of the smaller holiday resorts in the valley. The Tannheimer Tal is a high valley in the north-west of Tyrol and is promoted as a year-round destination for hikers, cyclists and winter sports enthusiasts. While one accommodation directory explicitly lists the establishment as a holiday apartment rental, the Tirol tourism portal assigns the entry to the category accommodation or the type "hotel".

History/Background

No reliable historical information about the house itself is documented in the available sources; it is run as a privately operated rental. The only reliably documented fact is that the establishment is registered as a holiday apartment rental at the location Nesselwängle 53 and that contact is made via the telephone number provided. Further information on the origins, tradition or history of the house cannot be derived from the sources consulted and is therefore deliberately not asserted.

Arrival

Nesselwängle lies in the Tannheimer Tal in the holiday region of the same name in Außerfern. The region is developed as an excursion and holiday destination all year round; specific details on arrival, parking and public transport for the house are not given in the sources evaluated. Interested parties should therefore arrange their arrival directly with the host on +43 5675 8278. Information about the region is provided by the Tannheimer Tal tourist board, based in Tannheim; the municipality of Nesselwängle (Nesselwängle 74, 6672 Nesselwängle) is also a point of contact on site.

Tips

As this is a privately run holiday apartment, prior contact by telephone is recommended to clarify availability, arrival and facilities. The village of Nesselwängle is a starting point for hikes and lies close to the Haldensee; in winter there are cross-country skiing trails in the surrounding area. For leisure, weather and event information, it is worth taking a look at the official portal of the Tannheimer Tal tourist board as well as the website of the municipality of Nesselwängle. Prices for the accommodation are not stated in the sources and are therefore not mentioned.

Best time to travel

The Tannheimer Tal is presented as a year-round region for summer and winter holidays. The warmer season is suitable for hiking and stays by the nearby Haldensee, while winter is for winter sports. No seasonal restriction or specific seasonal opening of the house itself is stated in the sources.
